steps.why: pkg-config knows a library once its package is there, and gives cc its flags.
As upstream installs it, -lpng links too.

steps.script: printf '#include <png.h>\nint main(void) { return png_create_write_struct(PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING, NULL, NULL, NULL) == NULL; }\n' > /tmp/amy-png.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags libpng) /tmp/amy-png.c $(pkg-config --static --libs libpng) -o /tmp/amy-png && /tmp/amy-png && cc /tmp/amy-png.c -lpng -lz -o /tmp/amy-png && /tmp/amy-png

printf '%s\n' '#include <ft2build.h>' '#include FT_FREETYPE_H' 'int main(void) { FT_Library library; FT_Face face; if (FT_Init_FreeType(&library) || FT_New_Face(library, "/usr/share/fonts/IosevkaTerm-SemiBold.ttf", 0, &face)) return 1; return face->num_glyphs < 100; }' > /tmp/amy-freetype.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags freetype2) /tmp/amy-freetype.c $(pkg-config --static --libs freetype2) -o /tmp/amy-freetype && /tmp/amy-freetype

steps.why: Swedish collation puts ö after z: ICU finds its data in /usr/share/icu/68.2.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <unicode/ucol.h>' 'int main() { UErrorCode status = U_ZERO_ERROR; UCollator *swedish = ucol_open("sv", &status); int failed = U_FAILURE(status) || ucol_strcollUTF8(swedish, "z", 1, "\xc3\xb6", 2, &status) != UCOL_LESS; ucol_close(swedish); return failed; }' > /tmp/amy-icu.cpp && c++ -O0 -DU_STATIC_IMPLEMENTATION /tmp/amy-icu.cpp -licui18n -licuuc -licudata -o /tmp/amy-icu && /tmp/amy-icu

steps.why: A square wave played from a buffer is in the samples the loopback device renders.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#define AL_ALEXT_PROTOTYPES' '#include <AL/al.h>' '#include <AL/alc.h>' '#include <AL/alext.h>' 'int main() { ALCdevice *device = alcLoopbackOpenDeviceSOFT(0); int format[] = { ALC_FORMAT_CHANNELS_SOFT, ALC_MONO_SOFT, ALC_FORMAT_TYPE_SOFT, ALC_SHORT_SOFT, ALC_FREQUENCY, 48000, 0 }; alcMakeContextCurrent(alcCreateContext(device, format)); short wave[4800], heard[4800]; int loud = 0; ALuint buffer, source; for (int at = 0; at < 4800; at++) wave[at] = at % 100 < 50 ? 12000 : -12000; alGenBuffers(1, &buffer); alGenSources(1, &source); alBufferData(buffer, AL_FORMAT_MONO16, wave, sizeof wave, 48000); alSourcei(source, AL_BUFFER, buffer); alSourcePlay(source); alcRenderSamplesSOFT(device, heard, 4800); for (int at = 0; at < 4800; at++) loud += heard[at] > 1000 || heard[at] < -1000; return loud < 2400 || alGetError() != AL_NO_ERROR; }' > /tmp/amy-openal.cpp && c++ -O0 /tmp/amy-openal.cpp -lopenal -o /tmp/amy-openal && /tmp/amy-openal

steps.why: A program links ENet: its version, an address and a reliable packet; its sockets go to the relay.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <enet/enet.h>' '#include <string.h>' 'int main(void) {' '  if (enet_initialize() || enet_linked_version() != ENET_VERSION) return 1;' '  ENetAddress address;' '  if (enet_address_set_host_ip(&address, "10.0.0.42")) return 1;' '  ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create("Dolly", 6, ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);' '  int ok = packet && packet->dataLength == 6 && !strcmp((char *)packet->data, "Dolly") &&' '      ((unsigned char *)&address.host)[3] == 42;' '  enet_packet_destroy(packet);' '  enet_deinitialize();' '  return ok ? 0 : 1;' '}' > /tmp/amy-enet.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags libenet) /tmp/amy-enet.c $(pkg-config --libs libenet) -o /tmp/amy-enet && /tmp/amy-enet
